methodology.scope: The same ten PDFs used by parser-gold-v04.
methodology.visual_unit: A page containing at least one meaning-bearing chart, roadmap, process/relationship diagram, portfolio map, or geographic/network map. Decorative covers, logos, and photo-only pages are excluded.
methodology.claim_sample: Three MOAT-relevant graphical claims per issuer, selected before measuring parser/evidence coverage.
methodology.strict_binary_rule: A relation passes only when the canonical output explicitly preserves it. Recoverable coordinates or a bag of nearby labels and numbers do not count as a semantic series/trend relation.
methodology.figure_detection_rule: A semantic figure requires an explicit chart/figure identity plus usable semantics such as caption, chart type, legend, or series metadata. OCR wrapper nodes do not count.
methodology.scoring_lane_rule: Atomic/evidence recall passes only when an item sourced to the audited page expresses the graphical claim, not merely another statement on the same page.
methodology.classification_gold_rule: Gold role and subtype follow structural-moat-rubric/9 and the observable-anchor adjudication in docs/ir-score-bearing-adjudication-v1.json. Patents, footprint, pipeline status, growth, technology efficacy, capacity, network size, cumulative orders, customer references, distribution, or ordinary performance movement alone are NONE unless the claim explicitly states a durable causal barrier or an allowed realized outcome.
methodology.score_bearing_recheck: The nine formerly score-bearing claims were manually re-adjudicated A/B/C from their rendered source pages without classifier outputs or return data. Seven remain score-bearing; one is relevant but non-score-bearing and one is insufficient.

claims.claim: Revenue fell 7%, rental-car revenue fell 8%, travel revenue rose 19%; operating profit fell 33%, rental-car profit fell 40%, and the travel loss narrowed 51%.
claims.gold_rationale: A one-year revenue and operating-profit comparison is ordinary performance movement. It neither shows persistent margin behavior nor links deterioration to erosion of an allowed MOAT anchor.
claims.note: Directional headline and anchors survive; chart-to-segment value binding is flattened.

claims.claim: Rental fleet declined to 17,042 in 2019 Q1 and then recovered to 19,664 by 2021 Q3.
claims.gold_rationale: Fleet size is an operating scale observation without an explicit barrier or allowed realized MOAT outcome.
claims.note: The single-series labels, dates, anchors, and textual direction survive.

claims.claim: Business-travel/event participants collapsed from roughly 110 thousand to 6,366 during COVID and remained near 11-13 thousand through 2021 Q3.
claims.gold_rationale: The external COVID demand shock does not identify an issuer-specific barrier, outcome, or competitive erosion.
claims.note: The chart labels and explicit COVID decline statement survive, but the claim never enters evidence.

claims.claim: Each named drug program is mapped to a distinct discovery, preclinical, or clinical stage in the R&D pipeline.
claims.gold_rationale: Pipeline stage is development status, not an observable economic barrier or realized MOAT outcome.
claims.note: Drug and stage labels survive as a bag of text; product-to-stage bars do not.

claims.claim: P4899 shows dose-dependent inhibition and differentiated experimental responses across the plotted models.
claims.gold_rationale: Preclinical efficacy alone does not state protection, switching friction, entry difficulty, or an allowed economic outcome.
claims.note: IC50/EC50 anchors and a textual dose-response conclusion survive; plotted series and image-to-condition identity do not.

claims.claim: Quarterly royalty revenue reached 2,101 million won in 2025 Q2 and management expected meaningful growth from the second half onward.
claims.gold_rationale: One royalty observation plus management guidance is growth evidence, not a permitted mechanism or outcome subtype.
claims.note: The single series and textual forecast survive; only a separate regulatory item reaches accepted evidence.

claims.claim: Domestic factories, R&D, sales, and service centers are distributed across Jincheon, Seoul, Chopyeong, Jeonju, and Yeongnam.
claims.gold_rationale: A geographic operating footprint does not by itself establish a scale-based entry barrier.
claims.note: Location-to-function bullets survive despite loss of the geographic map.

claims.claim: The company reports a global network of 130 dealers across 80 countries, supported by four subsidiaries and two branches.
claims.gold_rationale: Distribution reach and size alone do not state a network effect or durable causal barrier.
claims.note: The headline preserves the network cardinalities, but no evidence card uses them.

claims.claim: The patent/utility-model/design/brand portfolio totals 302 rights, split across domestic and overseas categories.
claims.gold_rationale: Patent and design counts alone do not establish an economically protected intangible barrier.
claims.note: Labels and numbers survive, but category-to-count binding is flattened.

claims.claim: Cumulative sputter orders expanded about 74.9 times to 6,746 hundred-million won while the company built a long customer reference history.
claims.gold_rationale: Cumulative orders and a long customer-reference claim do not directly show renewal, repeat ordering by the same customer, retention, churn, or installed-base reuse.
claims.note: The title, dates, anchors, and single cumulative series survive; the page is absent from evidence units.

claims.claim: A dated roadmap shows core sputter and automation capabilities extending from display into batteries, MLCC, semiconductor, and 3D-printing equipment.
claims.gold_rationale: Technology diversification and product expansion do not state a durable causal barrier.
claims.note: Most timeline labels survive in reading order, but the claim is not selected for evidence.

claims.claim: Twenty-five years of top-tier references support 1,383 cumulative system deliveries, including 675 overseas, alongside more than 250 patents and 44 R&D personnel.
claims.gold_rationale: Reference, delivery, patent, and staffing counts are capabilities and scale indicators without an explicit allowed outcome or barrier.
claims.note: An atomic unit exists, but number-to-label binding is damaged; accepted evidence drops the patent count and the broader installed-base claim.

claims.claim: 2021 Q3 revenue and profit rose sharply both quarter-on-quarter and year-on-year as advanced-process investment increased.
claims.gold_rationale: A single-quarter cyclical improvement is not persistence, margin stability, or a structural mechanism.
claims.note: The summary table is recoverable; the atomic lane retains only a generic cause statement and no accepted claim.

claims.claim: Five-quarter revenue, operating profit, and margin series show large quarter-to-quarter volatility rather than a smooth trend.
claims.gold_rationale: The multi-quarter series explicitly contradicts stable margins and earnings.
claims.score_bearing_component: Five consecutive quarterly operating-margin observations with large alternating changes.
claims.note: Series tables survive, but the volatility relation is not represented semantically.

claims.claim: The long-run application mix shifts across DRAM, NAND, and LSI/other while sales and operating margin evolve over 2011-2020.
claims.gold_rationale: Product-mix evolution alone is neither an allowed outcome nor a durable causal barrier.
claims.note: Years, percentages, and labels survive; stacked colors and series-to-value relations do not.

claims.claim: The pipeline maps RGN-259 and OKN-007 indications to explicit phase-1, phase-2, and phase-3 progress.
claims.gold_rationale: Clinical progress is development status and does not itself establish an economic moat.
claims.note: Detailed textual stage statements preserve much of the roadmap, but no atomic unit is created from the page.

claims.claim: OKN-007 plus TMZ shows median overall survival of 9.7 months versus 7.2 months for historical TMZ and a stated 25-29% improvement.
claims.gold_rationale: A clinical efficacy comparison is not yet an allowed realized economic outcome or structural barrier.
claims.note: Numeric outcomes and the stated comparison survive; survival-curve line identity does not.

claims.claim: Annual cold-chain and other-business revenue series show the composition and direction of the segment's recent sales trend.
claims.gold_rationale: Segment revenue composition and growth are operating observations, not MOAT evidence under the frozen ontology.
claims.note: Chart titles and legends survive, but plotted values and the trend do not.

claims.claim: K-CAB exceeded 100 billion won in cumulative prescriptions, reached 9.3 billion won monthly, and became the number-one ulcer-drug product by market share.
claims.gold_rationale: The claim states a realized issuer-product number-one market-share outcome.
claims.score_bearing_component: K-CAB's explicit number-one market-share rank; prescription value and clinic coverage are supporting context only.
claims.note: Headline outcomes and anchors survive, but plotted category/series binding does not and the page produces no accepted evidence.

claims.claim: K-CAB licensing agreements cover 24 countries, with partner- and market-specific development and launch plans.
claims.gold_rationale: Licensing breadth and future launch plans do not by themselves identify an allowed outcome or protected barrier.
claims.note: The table-like map remains legible in canonical text; it is not promoted into evidence.

claims.claim: Condition maintains number-one hangover-product share and very high convenience-store distribution, while Hutgaesoo remains a leading functional drink.
claims.gold_rationale: The claim explicitly states maintained number-one category share. Distribution reach is supporting context and is not score-bearing by itself.
claims.note: The number-one statement and percentages survive; pie/bar color-to-brand mappings are flattened.

claims.claim: Global Tax Free is presented as the domestic leader with 70-75% tax-refund market share.
claims.gold_rationale: The issuer is explicitly linked to a realized domestic market-share outcome.
claims.score_bearing_component: The issuer's 70-75% numeric share and domestic number-one rank.
claims.note: The share label is textually recoverable, but the atomic lane selects a different competitor fact.

claims.claim: The merchant network expanded from 826 locations in 2011 to roughly 11.8 thousand by the latest period.
claims.gold_rationale: Network expansion alone does not state self-reinforcing economics, switching friction, or entry difficulty.
claims.note: Chronology and anchors survive, but no explicit upward relation is produced and no evidence is created.

claims.claim: Online payment channels and offline airport/city refund infrastructure form an integrated refund network.
claims.gold_rationale: Channel topology is a capability description without an explicit network effect or scale-based barrier.
claims.note: Channel and location labels survive, but their network topology is lost.

claims.claim: Euvichol supplies more than 90% of the UNICEF public market; supply rose to 19.21 million doses, supported by 25 million annual dose capacity and a 2021 UNICEF contract for 33.6 million doses worth 42.1 billion won.
claims.gold_rationale: The page explicitly identifies issuer-product supply above 90% of the UNICEF public market, a realized share outcome. Contract, capacity, and supply-volume figures are supporting context only.
claims.score_bearing_component: Euvichol's explicit supply of more than 90% of the UNICEF public market.
claims.note: Numbers and series labels survive; the supply trajectory is not represented and accepted evidence concerns a neighboring cost claim.

claims.claim: EcML is presented as a directly produced E. coli-derived adjuvant that avoids GLA's 30-plus synthesis steps and associated high cost.
claims.gold_rationale: The side-by-side process comparison explicitly links direct production and fewer steps to lower manufacturing cost.
claims.score_bearing_component: Direct EcML-versus-GLA comparison on process steps, production time, and manufacturing cost.
claims.note: The side-by-side textual comparison survives; the platform advantage is never selected into evidence.

claims.claim: The vaccine and biologics roadmap maps each program to dated preclinical, clinical, approval, and WHO-PQ milestones through 2024.
claims.gold_rationale: Roadmap and regulatory milestones are development status, not an established barrier or economic outcome.
claims.note: Products, dates, and stages survive as flattened text; program-to-stage bar geometry is lost.

claims.claim: SMART-RC2 treatment increases selected phytochemicals by 25x and 13x and total polyphenol content by about 2x versus control.
claims.gold_rationale: Technical efficacy versus control does not state economic protection, switching cost, or an allowed realized outcome.
claims.note: Anchors and an explicit increase statement survive; bar/series identities are flattened.

claims.claim: The platform is supported by 65-plus SCI papers, 114-plus IP rights, 250-plus developed cell lines, and 48% R&D staff.
claims.gold_rationale: Research, IP, cell-line, and staffing counts are capability indicators without an explicit durable barrier.
claims.note: All labels and figures exist, but their infographic spatial pairing is flattened; page-spanning atomic refs do not express this claim.

claims.claim: Revenue compounded at 24% over 2011-2023 while the company remained profitable for eleven consecutive years.
claims.gold_rationale: Eleven consecutive profitable years are a realized long-run profitability-stability outcome; growth alone is not the basis.
claims.score_bearing_component: Eleven consecutive profitable years; the multi-year operating-margin series corroborates the claim and revenue CAGR is supporting context only.
claims.note: The chart headline explicitly preserves the long-run result; it does not reach the scoring lane.
